decisive_spans.text: a 6 cm mass arising from the muscularis propria of the gastric antrum

response.rationale: Both D1 and D7 are Gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST). D1 is a more general term, while D7 is more specific. The vignette supports the diagnosis of GIST with the presence of a large antral mass arising from the muscularis propria of the gastric antrum. Since D1 is a more general term and D7 is a more specific term for the same disease, D1 is chosen as the champion.
